signals.subject: Yurkovich Family Pavilion — Richmond Hospital Phase 2 awarded to Graham + HDR Alliance
signals.detail: $1.96B Alliance Partnership delivery model. Vancouver Coastal Health selected Graham Design Builders LP + HDR Architecture Associates Sept 2024. Contract award Feb 2025. Phase 2 construction starts 2026, completes 2029. STRUCTURAL ENGINEER = Entuitive (confirmed via Entuitive's Jan 2026 15-year anniversary scholarship announcement: 'Alliance Partnership at Richmond Hospital in B.C.'). Yurkovich structural scope is locked for KOR.

signals.subject: Cariboo Memorial Hospital ($366M) awarded to Stantec + Graham (progressive design-build)
signals.detail: Williams Lake / Cariboo-Chilcotin. Progressive design-build model, one of the first BC healthcare projects to use this delivery. Stantec provides clinical planning, equipment planning, architectural design, structural and civil engineering IN HOUSE — closed shop, no external structural sub slot.

signals.subject: Dawson Creek and District Hospital ($590M) awarded to Graham Design Builders + HDR
signals.detail: 263,000 sq ft greenfield replacement hospital. Northern Health + Infrastructure BC. Graham signed design-build agreement; HDR is prime consultant. narratives.paragraphText: Graham Design Builders LP is a Calgary-headquartered, employee-owned construction solutions partner providing general contracting, design-build, construction management, and P3 services. Their BC office network covers Vancouver, Coquitlam, Abbotsford, Kamloops, and Kelowna. Over the last 24 months Graham has built a $3.4B+ active BC healthcare design-build pipeline: Richmond Hospital Yurkovich Pavilion ($1.96B with HDR + Entuitive Alliance), Cariboo Memorial Hospital ($366M with Stantec progressive design-build), Dawson Creek and District Hospital ($590M with HDR), and Stuart Lake Hospital. They are on ReNew Canada Top 100 Infrastructure Projects 2026. Their structural-engineering partnering pattern is HDR-paired projects get an external structural sub (Entuitive on Richmond), Stantec-paired projects get Stantec in-house structural (closed shop).

Direct outreach to Alex Trifunov (Pre-construction Manager, Vancouver office) to position KOR on Graham's next BC healthcare pursuits — especially HDR-paired projects where the external structural sub slot is open. Two specific live intel gaps: Dawson Creek Hospital structural engineer is not publicly named, and Stuart Lake Hospital full team is undisclosed. Verifying these with Trifunov is the immediate move. The 12-month play is Month 1-2 LinkedIn or email outreach plus in-person meeting at Graham Vancouver office, Month 3-6 KOR positioned on Graham's pre-qualified structural-sub list, Month 6-12 pursuit response on a non-Stantec Graham pursuit. Secondary outreach to Blake Christian (EVP US Buildings) for KOR's US West Coast healthcare strategy. KOR's BC healthcare structural portfolio plus mid-rise concrete plus seismic experience is the pitch — concrete, named, with case studies.
